After breakfast, you will take a speedboat to the communities of Santo Antonio and Tiririca.

A forest walk is included.

You will then have lunch in a local family's home.

The main dish is Amazonian fish cooked over an open fire.

After lunch, the route continues to Tiririca Beach in Anavilhanas National Park.

There will be time for a swim here.

You will then walk to the large Macucu tree, regarded as the archipelago's principal tree.

During the high-water season, the speedboat heads to the community of Sobrado.

A walk along rainforest trails is included.

The program mentions a visit to a large samaúma tree.

Lunch is served in a traditional local home, where Amazonian fish is also prepared.

The route then continues to the Macucu tree in the Paraná das Araras area.

A jungle walk is included.

You may encounter wildlife along the way.

Possible sightings include sloths, parrots and tapir tracks near the water.

After the excursion, return to the lodge.

Dinner at CamuCamu restaurant.

Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included on this day.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, the final boat journey toward Manaus begins.

The first stop is the Meeting of the Waters of the Rio Negro and Solimões.

This natural phenomenon is also known as the 'marriage of the rivers'.

The dark waters of the Rio Negro and the yellowish waters of the Solimões flow side by side without mixing.

The visible boundary between them continues for about 6 km.

The color of the Solimões is attributed to the large amount of suspended sediment, while the dark color of the Rio Negro comes from substances washed into the river from its surroundings.

The water temperature differs at the boundary between the 2 currents.

The Amazon proper begins where they join.

Nearby, you can see giant Victoria Regia water lilies.

The next part of the day is swimming with pink Amazon river dolphins.

The pink dolphin is known locally as boto cor-de-rosa.

They are described as one of the rare freshwater dolphin species.

The program allows you to feed and touch them.

Lunch is then served at a floating restaurant on the river.

Afterward, transfer to Manaus airport.

This concludes the VIP program.

Breakfast and lunch are included.
